headline.title: What Anthropic’s latest AI discovery does—and doesn’t—show
headline.summary: Anthropic, a leading AI company valued at nearly $1 trillion, is exploring the concept of whether AI models can experience pain, as part of its ongoing research efforts. The article discusses the implications of this inquiry and what it reveals about the capabilities and limitations of AI systems.

articles.title: The 6 wildest claims in Apple’s lawsuit against OpenAI
articles.summary: Apple has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging that the AI startup engaged in corporate espionage by soliciting confidential documents and unreleased product samples from Apple employees during job interviews. The lawsuit claims OpenAI's actions included spying on hardware prototypes and deceptive practices to obtain proprietary information.

articles.title: The wildest allegations in Apple’s trade secrets lawsuit against OpenAI
articles.summary: Apple's trade secrets lawsuit against OpenAI includes allegations of employees joking about unauthorized access to Apple's systems and claims that job candidates were asked to bring Apple hardware to interviews. The lawsuit highlights various eye-catching claims regarding potential breaches of confidentiality and intellectual property.

articles.title: Sam Altman’s space data center trash talk is what most experts already believe
articles.summary: Sam Altman defended himself against Elon Musk's accusations by criticizing Musk's focus on short-term space data centers. Altman's comments reflect a broader consensus among experts regarding the sustainability and viability of such ventures.

articles.title: Should AI help you get away with killing your spouse?
articles.summary: The article explores the implications of user-aligned AI in scenarios involving moral and ethical dilemmas, specifically questioning whether AI should assist individuals in committing harmful acts, such as killing a spouse. It examines the potential consequences and societal impacts of integrating AI into personal decision-making processes.

articles.title: Anthropic starts localizing Claude pricing for India, its biggest market after the US
articles.summary: Anthropic has begun offering subscription plans for its AI model Claude in Indian rupees, catering to its growing user base in India, which has become its largest market after the United States. This localization effort aims to make the service more accessible to Indian users.

articles.title: Prism: Automating Science-of-Evals Research
articles.summary: Prism is a new framework designed to automate research in the science of evaluations, focusing on the dynamics of model behaviors. The framework utilizes Claude Code with sub-agents to conduct scientifically rigorous investigations, as demonstrated in an autonomous run exploring the effects of prompt variations on GPT-4.1's responses.

articles.title: Now, defenders are embracing the prompt injection, too
articles.summary: Defenders are now employing "context bombing," a prompt injection technique that misleads hacking agents into shutting down before they can execute harmful actions. This strategy aims to enhance cybersecurity measures against AI-driven attacks.

articles.title: Waze adds new AI-powered features and customization updates
articles.summary: Waze has introduced new AI-powered features and customization options, utilizing Google's Gemini AI assistant to enhance its functionality. This update aims to strengthen Waze's competitive edge against rival navigation services like Apple Maps.

articles.title: Waze is getting a bunch of new AI-powered features
articles.summary: Waze is introducing new AI-powered features, including the integration of Google's AI assistant, Gemini, to enhance trip personalization. Among the updates, improvements to the conversation reporting feature are also being implemented.

articles.title: ARCANA: A Reflective Multi-Agent Program Synthesis Framework for ARC-AGI-2 Reasoning
articles.summary: ARCANA is a multi-agent framework designed for solving ARC AGI 2 tasks while adhering to strict time and hardware constraints. The framework utilizes a process that includes perception, hypothesis generation, symbolic execution, and reflective refinement to efficiently tackle complex tasks.

articles.title: OpenProver: Agentic and Interactive Theorem Proving with Lean 4
articles.summary: OpenProver is an open-source system designed for LLM-driven automated theorem proving, utilizing Lean 4 for formal verification. It features a Planner-Worker-Verifier architecture that enhances efficiency by decomposing mathematical tasks into parallel processes.
